brief:
Palestinian visual artist Suleiman Mansour, creator of the iconic painting "Camel of Loads," has died, Shehab Wire reported. Mansour was a prominent figure in Palestinian contemporary art whose work became widely recognized across the Arab world and established him as a leading voice in Palestinian artistic expression.

The artist's painting "Camel of Loads" became a defining work in his career, cementing his reputation as a key figure in Palestinian visual culture. Mansour's artistic practice centered on themes of Palestinian identity and cultural heritage, influencing generations of artists in the region and beyond.
